from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, re, subprocess, time
root = Path('/tmp/ramsey-excess-7fJr29')
baseline = (root/'before.opb').read_bytes()
base_body = baseline.split(b'\n',1)[1]
commands = []
results = []
output = root/'model.opb'
base_command = ['./build/ramsey','data/r45_24/b24.g6','-g','-o',str(output)]
def invoke(flags, success=True):
    command = base_command + flags
    started = time.monotonic()
    run = subprocess.run(command, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    commands.append({'command':command,'exit_status':run.returncode,'stderr':run.stderr.strip(),'wall_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,4)})
    assert run.returncode == (0 if success else 2), (command,run.stderr)
    return run

def parsed_suffix(data, expected_count):
    header, body = data.split(b'\n',1)
    assert header == f'* #variable= 585 #constraint= {383686+expected_count}'.encode()
    assert body.startswith(base_body), 'existing model prefix changed'
    rows = []
    for line in body[len(base_body):].decode().splitlines():
        left,right = line.split(' >= ')
        tokens = left.split()
        terms = [(int(tokens[i]),int(tokens[i+1][1:])) for i in range(0,len(tokens),2)]
        rows.append((terms,int(right.removesuffix(';'))))
    assert len(rows)==expected_count
    return rows

invoke([])
assert output.read_bytes()==baseline
results.append('Default model byte-identical to pre-change baseline')
invoke(['--neighborhood-excess-min','none','--neighborhood-excess-max','none'])
assert output.read_bytes()==baseline
results.append('Explicitly disabled excess bounds preserve baseline bytes')
pairs = [(u,v) for u in range(18) for v in range(u+1,18)]
a_ids = {p:i+1 for i,p in enumerate(pairs)}
weighted = [(2,i) for i in range(1,154)] + [(1,i) for i in range(154,586)]
for flags,low,high in [
    (['--neighborhood-excess-min','0','--neighborhood-excess-max','0'],0,0),
    (['--neighborhood-excess-min','3','--neighborhood-excess-max','7'],3,7),
    (['--neighborhood-excess-min','2147483647'],2147483647,None),
    (['--neighborhood-excess-max','4'],None,4),
    (['--neighborhood-excess-max','2147483647'],None,None)
]:
    invoke(flags)
    expected = []
    if low is not None: expected.append((weighted,306+low))
    if high is not None: expected.append(([(-c,v) for c,v in weighted],-306-high))
    assert parsed_suffix(output.read_bytes(),len(expected))==expected
    results.append('Validated aggregate flags: '+' '.join(flags))
expected_zero = []
for u in range(18):
    terms = [(1,a_ids[tuple(sorted((u,v)))]) for v in range(18) if v!=u]
    terms += [(1,154+24*u+y) for y in range(24)]
    expected_zero.extend([(terms,17),([(-c,v) for c,v in terms],-17)])
invoke(['--zero-neighborhood-excess'])
zero_model = output.read_bytes()
assert parsed_suffix(zero_model,36)==expected_zero
results.append('Zero-excess mode emits the 18 global-degree equations with pivot contribution included')
invoke(['--neighborhood-excess-min','0','--neighborhood-excess-max','0','--zero-neighborhood-excess'])
combined = output.read_bytes()
assert parsed_suffix(combined,38)==[(weighted,306),([(-c,v) for c,v in weighted],-306)]+expected_zero
results.append('Aggregate and per-vertex components compose without changing the prior prefix or variable IDs')
preserved = hashlib.sha256(combined).hexdigest()
for flags in [
    ['--neighborhood-excess-min','2','--neighborhood-excess-max','1'],
    ['--neighborhood-excess-min','-1'],
    ['--neighborhood-excess-max','garbage'],
    ['--neighborhood-excess-min','2147483648'],
    ['--neighborhood-excess-min'],
    ['--zero-neighborhood-excess=1']
]:
    invoke(flags,success=False)
    assert hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==preserved
results.append('6 invalid-option cases reject with status 2 and preserve the existing output')
smoke_evidence = {'commands':commands,'checks':results,'baseline_sha256':hashlib.sha256(baseline).hexdigest(),
                  'zero_mode_sha256':hashlib.sha256(zero_model).hexdigest(),
                  'combined_sha256':preserved,'baseline_bytes':len(baseline),'combined_bytes':len(combined),
                  'model_sizes':{'default_rows':383686,'zero_rows':383722,'combined_rows':383724,'variables':585}}
